On Thursday, 23 May 2013 09:45:13 UTC+1, brianw wrote:
Hi,
I'm fairly new at using GGPLOT and I'm trying to superimpose some point plots of
 means on a facet grid of boxplots.  I'm probably going about it the wrong way
 but what I've done seems very close but not quite what I'm looking for. Here's
  the plotting code:
  
 p  <- ggplot(bb)
 p  <- p + aes(x=BMI,y=sumcost,colour=diaCVD)
 p  <- p + geom_boxplot(outlier.size=1)
 p  <- p + scale_y_log10()
 p  <- p + facet_grid(ses.tertile ~ location)
 p  <- p + ylab("Individual costs of hospitalisations 2000 to 2008 - Log Scale")
 pd <- ggplot_build(p)    # get detail of facet boxplot layout
 xb <- pd$data[[1]]$x      # panel x-coordinates of boxplots
 mc <- dfS$AvCost           # mean costs for the boxes
  p <- p + geom_point(aes(x=xb,y=AvCost,colour=diaCVD),data=dfS)
 print(p)

 Some of my boxplots don't appear because there is no data under those
 conditions. The code seems to work except where there are both blue
 (dia-nCVD) and green (nDia-CVD) boxes when the xcoordinates have been switched.
 Can anyone suggest a simpler way to produce the plot, or perhaps a suggestion
 as to how I might sort out the problem with my own code?
Thanks for any help.

Cheers
